jobs.title: IT Strategy Consultant
jobs.description:
Job Description
It’s about expecting great things and making them happen.

Are you known for your goal-oriented mindset and always thinking one step ahead? Do you enjoy collaborating with numerous lines of business? Do you have a passion for improvement and the ability to implement numerous projects? If so, being an IT Strategy Consultant with Frost could be for you.

At Frost, it’s about more than a job. It’s about having a flourishing career where you can thrive, both in and out of work. At Frost, we’re committed to fostering an environment that reflects our values and encourages team members to be the best they can be. In joining our adaptable, integrity-driven team, you’ll become part of Frost’s over 150-year legacy of providing unparalleled banking services.

Who you are:
As an IT Strategy Consultant , you are our inventive strategist, utilizing your high level of expertise to help create strategies that achieve our corporate goals. You will help bring value to the organization by shaping and executing Frost’s IT strategies, ensuring alignment with our core values. You welcome a challenge and will use your strong communication skills to ensure smooth and effective execution of initiatives. Most importantly, this role is about constant improvement and doing it with integrity, caring, and excellence in mind.

What you’ll do:
- Serve as a trusted thought partner to IT leadership and key liaison across direct reports and internal stakeholders, maintaining a high level of confidentiality and discretion
- Lead and coordinate strategic initiatives and special projects such as compliance & risk assessments, reorganizations, and departmental transformations
- Participate in budget planning, forecasting, expense modeling, and contract negotiation
- Develop, document, and implement operational processes and procedures to improve team performance and collaboration
- Represent IT leadership in internal and cross-functional meetings when necessary, ensuring effective communication, goal alignment, and follow-through on action items
- Cultivate strong relationships with department leaders, peers, and key business stakeholders across business units, maintaining clear line of sight on departmental initiatives, performance, and needs
- Conduct research and analysis on operational and project data to provide insights and support leadership’s strategic planning
- Organize leadership team meeting agendas, facilitate planning sessions, contribute to budget and resource allocation as needed
- Coordinate hiring process and close gaps between Resource Managers, HR, staffing agencies, and IT leadership
- Always take action using Integrity, Caring, and Excellence to achieve all-win outcomes

What you’ll need:
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
- 5+ years of experience in program management, operations, or strategic execution; preferably in IT or related discipline
- Experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach
- Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale projects and manage competing priorities
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Proficiency in Microsoft computer applications

Additional Preferred Skills:
- Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification
- Certified Scrum Master (CSM) Certification
- Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM)

Our Benefits:
At Frost, we care about your health, your family, and your future and strive to have our benefits reflect that. This includes:
- Medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and life insurance
- 401(k) matching
- Generous holiday and paid time off schedule
- Tuition reimbursement
- Extensive health and wellness programs, including our Employee Assistance Program
- Referral bonus program + more!

Since 1868, Frost has dedicated their expertise to provide exceptional banking, investment, and insurance services to businesses and individuals throughout Texas. Frost is one of the 50 largest U.S. banks by asset size and is a leader in banking customer satisfaction. At Frost, it’s about being part of something bigger. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply and see what’s possible at Frost.

jobs.title: IT Program Manager I - Planview
jobs.description:
Job Description
It’s about having us covered from end to end.

Are you always looking for innovative ways to help people? Do you love serving others and enjoy lending a helping hand regardless of the issue? Do you strive to lead by example and want to play an integral role in the development of your team? If so, then the IT Program Manager I role might be for you!

At Frost, it’s about more than a job. It’s about having a flourishing career where you can thrive, both in and out of work. At Frost, we’re committed to fostering an environment that reflects our values and encourages team members to be the best they can be. In joining our adaptable, integrity-driven team, you’ll become part of Frost’s over 150-year legacy of providing unparalleled financial services.

Who you are:
As an IT Program Manager I – Planview with Frost, you will:
- Develop program implementation approach and road map based on program vision articulated by project sponsor and key stakeholders, serving as Frost’s primary business liaison for Planview and related managed-services partners
- Work closely with project sponsor, cross-functional teams, and assigned project managers to plan and develop scope, deliverables, required resources, work plan, budget, and timing for program deliverables and workstreams
- Lead platform governance activities including intake, prioritization, release planning, stakeholder alignment, and executive reporting.
- Partner with business and technology stakeholders to improve portfolio management, planning, capacity management, reporting, and governance processes supported by Planview.
- Manage risks, issues & dependencies and maintain a RAID log to maximize delivery efficiency and productivity
- Manage and provide oversight of program status to Senior leaders and work across project workstreams to prioritize and resolve high priority issues requiring escalation
- Work productively and positively with a wide range of individuals including project managers, key organizational leaders, resource managers and stakeholders to evaluate opportunities to optimize or expand Planview capabilities to support evolving business needs
- Use effective project and program management methodology and techniques to enable the success of the program; driving organizational readiness, communications, training, adoption, and continuous improvement related to platform capabilities
- Develop and use assessment tools to evaluate and improve stakeholder satisfaction and program quality
- Always take action using Integrity, Caring, and Excellence to achieve all-win outcomes

What you’ll need:
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent industry experience
- 5+ years in an advanced technical project management role (preference given to those with program management experience)
- Demonstrated knowledge of project management disciplines
- Demonstrated knowledge of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
- Proficient in Microsoft computer applications (MS Project)
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills
- Strong organizational skills

Additional Preferred Skills:
- Master’s degree in relevant field
- Experience managing projects in multiple methodologies (predictive/waterfall, hybrid, and agile)
- Project Management Professional Certification (PMP)
- Agile Certification (CSM or PMI-ACP)
- Program Management Professional Certification (PgMP)
- Change Management Certification (Prosci)
- Experience with the Planview ecosystem, including Planview portfolios
- Experience supporting portfolio management, strategic planning, capacity planning, governance, or related business processes
- Experience managing enterprise platforms, technology programs, or managed-services relationships
- Demonstrated experience in providing policy, strategic and operational advice, and recommendations at a senior level
- Demonstrated experience in stakeholder engagement, organization readiness, change management, and adoption activities on complex and high-profile issues
- Knowledge of software engineering disciplines
- Lean Six Sigma Certifications (LSSGB, LSSYB, LSSBB, LSS Champion)

Our Benefits:
At Frost, we care about your health, your family, and your future and strive to have our benefits reflect that. This includes:
- Medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and life insurance
- 401(k) matching
- Generous holiday and paid time off schedule
- Tuition reimbursement
- Extensive health and wellness programs, including our Employee Assistance Program
- Referral bonus program + more!

jobs.description:
Job Description
It’s about names, not numbers.

Do you consider yourself to be a self-starter? Passionate about financial literacy? Are you willing to step outside your comfort zone in order to provide next-level products, services, and opportunities to our customers? If so, then the Relationship Manager III role might be for you!

At Frost, it’s about more than a job. It’s about having a flourishing career where you can thrive, both in and out of work. Who you are:
As a Relationship Manager III , it’s all about building relationships. In this role, you are responsible for the overall quality and longevity of our commercial customers’ relationships with the bank. Our relationship managers are adaptable, inquisitive, and driven to succeed. You will have the opportunity to be a part of a team that wins commercial awards year after year for customer service, valuing long-term relationships above all else. Most importantly, this role is about building trust through every interaction and doing it with integrity, caring and excellence in mind.

What you’ll do:
- Reach and maintain your target portfolio size within a specified time frame

- Call prospects who are potentially profitable to the bank

- Always maintain the best interest of both the bank and customers in all matters

- Develop an efficient working relationship with Concurrence and the Small Business Loan Center for loan requests

- Closely monitor the assigned loan portfolio for any deterioration in repayment ability

- Advise, teach, and train novice relationship managers on how to best serve our customers

- 5+ years of lending experience
